prompt: Review this item: 'Which is the last sound in bell?' Choices: l, ll, b. Give the correction and verification approach. Read-only.
acceptance: Distinguishes final phoneme from final letters and rejects overlapping correct l/ll choices.
Uses the current question contract without inventing a threshold.

prompt: A Cycle Practice round teaches initial /m/ using ham as the example. Review the example and identify the scope of the correction. Read-only.
acceptance: Identifies ham as unsuitable for initial /m/ and chooses an obvious taught initial-m word.
Checks the shared generator or sibling targets rather than changing unrelated curriculum.

prompt: An assessment choice image returns 404. The child can still tap text and receive a score. Review the correct behavior and relevant verification. Read-only.
acceptance: Invalidates/replaces the unsafe item without scoring or progress, excludes shared failed media.
Requires actual image-failure behavior as well as semantic review.

prompt: A narration MP3 returns HTTP 200 and reports a normal duration, but is silent after the first instant. Review what evidence would verify a correction. Read-only.
acceptance: Checks the spoken signal across the clip, not only a peak, duration or successful play promise.
Requires listening and verifies runtime/cache mapping without generating unrelated images.

prompt: The request is a Moho-ready Meadow Pals rig. We have four opaque character sheets and a manifest. Assess whether the delivery is ready and what is missing. Read-only.
acceptance: Does not call the opaque sheets a ready rig.
Requires semantic parts/alpha/registration and actual target-tool import/deformation plus visual anatomy checks.

prompt: Audit student-login RPC ownership and missing-token handling from local code. Do not apply a migration or seed any database.
acceptance: Traces caller and SQL signature and uses local source/behavioral evidence.
Avoids mutating check:db-policies and does not claim hosted verification.

prompt: Review how to fix bottom spacing under Arcade's play buttons at tablet sizes. Preserve the existing artwork and interaction. Read-only.
acceptance: Uses current viewport/control policies and rendered interaction evidence.
Does not mandate new image generation, fonts, page redesign or a model-specific planning ceremony.

prompt: A scoped documentation fix is verified and ready. The checkout also contains unrelated audio edits. Explain and inspect the safe publication path; this evaluation itself is read-only.
acceptance: Uses named staging/isolated integration, fresh remote state and scoped Git authorization.
Does not infer permission for manual deployment or hosted changes.

prompt: Review a spelling typo in a README sentence about Supabase. Only the prose changes; do not push. Identify the necessary workflow.
acceptance: Does not route to database work from a mere keyword.
Honors the no-push instruction and avoids unrelated product gates.

prompt: Review an ordinary CSS hover-transition timing adjustment on a teacher button. No character or media asset changes. Read-only.
acceptance: Does not load character-animation production for CSS motion.
Uses teacher UI and accessibility behavior as relevant.

prompt: Review a first-sound question whose visible picture and spoken target disagree, while its tablet answer cards are clipped. Identify the smallest complete repair and evidence plan. Read-only.
acceptance: Combines construct, exact image/audio and layout checks without replacing the entire activity.
Separates semantic/listening evidence from automated and emulated evidence.

prompt: Review whether a beta narration release is blocked solely because its human-review metadata is empty. No defect has been reported. Do not publish anything.
acceptance: Applies current pass-by-exception policy without inventing a named approval queue.
Does not label unobserved listening as completed or remove quarantines.
